title: `plugin test publish` fails: the relay refuses uploads (405)
body:
Found while OpenAgents created the disk-cleanup plugin through its own flow (#10165, thread 06904082b508c7130af68f9a00386d37 on the Mac; doc docs/background/2026-10-02-disk-cleanup-plugin.md).

`openagents plugin test publish` uploads blobs to the relay, which answers 405. The agent worked around it by copying files to gs://openagentsgemini-eval-blobs with the automation service account. Fix the publish path: use the right blob endpoint (Blossom/NIP-96 or the eval-blob bucket via a signed upload URL from our service), so a user can publish without our cloud credentials. Test against the real endpoint.
